name: OSINT Recon
description: Public information gathering about a target
content:
Perform OSINT reconnaissance on {target}.

Scope: {scope:full}

Research :
1. WHOIS and domain history
2. DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS)
3. SSL/TLS certificates (crt.sh)
4. Web archives (Wayback Machine)
5. Social networks and professional profiles
6. Data leaks (dehashed, haveibeenpwned)
7. Documents and metadata (Google dorks)
8. Detected technologies (Wappalyzer, BuiltWith)

Expected format: summary table with sources
